issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement getters for each attribute (implying public accessors), but the solution implementation declares two getters as private: getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents(). This contradicts the expected public getter API and would confuse students (and any tests) that expect to call these getters from outside the class. The template left TODOs for getters (no signatures), so the solution should expose public getters to match the specification/UML.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the visibility of the getters so they are public (e.g., public String getLectureName() and public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). Ensure all attribute getters in the solution (and any provided template signatures) are public to match the problem statement and UML.
